items.question: What ritual count is prescribed for the situated forehead syllable mass before addressing the worshipped god?
premises: The forehead syllable mass is situated.
A hundred thousand is to be done.
items.inference: The practitioner completes a hundred thousand repetitions of the situated forehead syllable mass before invoking the worshipped god.
uncertainties: The exact ritual object of kṛtya is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having situated the forehead-syllable-mass, do a hundred thousand, O worshipped god.
